page_summary: The World Bank survey indicates that recent cybersecurity risk assessments are more prevalent in high-income countries compared to low- and middle-income countries. Among high-income respondents, 79% reported conducting such assessments in the past 24 months, while the figures drop significantly in lower-income contexts. This disparity is attributed to the varying maturity levels of legal requirements across different income categories.

regions.label: Figure 7
regions.description: Bar chart showing the percentage of responses regarding whether ports have conducted a cybersecurity risk assessment in the past 24 months across different income categories: High income, Upper-middle income, Lower-middle income, and Low income. The chart includes three response categories: Yes (dark blue), No (red), and Prefer not to say (yellow).
